o1.biggest_strength: The inclusion of a geo-holdout test for retargeting perfectly addresses the rubric's incrementality requirement while protecting cash.
o1.biggest_mistake: Applying the 86% tracking gap adjustment to individual break-evens is smart, but a one-sentence formula explaining exactly how it alters the ad set targets would make it fully transparent.
o1.what_would_make_it_a_10: It is already a 10, acting as a rigorous custodian of the business's cash flow.

o2.biggest_mistake: Scaling the Catalog DPA by 20% despite it already having a very high 7-day frequency of 5.2 risks burning out the audience quickly.

reason: Both outputs are exceptional and caught every signal in the data. Output 1 wins for its uncompromising financial discipline—refusing to scale until the account proves itself—and its brilliant geo-holdout test to measure true lift.
